<!-- record-ancestry-glasgow-bb7cb63f9cc1: George Glasgow -->
[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
George Glasgow died in 1816 aged 7 and is commemorated at Leadhills Cemetery, Lanarkshire, Scotland.<ref name="anc370985">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/62497/records/370985 Ancestry, Scotland, Burial Monument Inscriptions, 1507-2024, George Glasgow, 1816, Leadhills Cemetery, Lanarkshire, Scotland]. Ancestry index transcript inspected 2026-11-04; original images uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Identity review, 2026-11-04: Glasgow-1307 (George Glasgow of Kirknewton, son of John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle) was removed: the monument makes this George, died 21 July 1816 aged 7, one of the children of Janet Thomson and William Glasgow, gamekeeper to the Earl of Hopetoun. Those parents are Thomson-14488 and Glasgow-2715 of Crawford parish, which includes Leadhills; George is held as a new draft. Son of William Glasgow (Glasgow-2715), gamekeeper to the Earl of Hopetoun, and Janet Thomson (Thomson-14488), on their Leadhills monument. The later George (Glasgow-638, born 1818) is a younger brother of the same name, not this child. No catalogue profile represents this child.
